title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.13.11: Renamed four Swap cards to fit the Swap theme of interacting with the audience — Role Reversal is now Crowd Work, Body Double is now Win Them Over, Upstage is now All Eyes on Me, and Trading Fours is now Pass the Mic. Names only; no card effects changed.
